title: ONE PIECE
synopsis:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.

Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.

*This includes the following special episodes:

- Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore! (Episode 336)

- The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle! (Episode 492)

- Team Formation! Save Chopper (Episode 542)

- History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (Episode 590)

- 20th Anniversary! Special Romance Dawn (Episode 907)

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
episodes.synopsis: A group of pirates lead by Alvida plunder a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a mission to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Coby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

episodes.title: Enter the Great Swordsman! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Coby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

episodes.title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
episodes.synopsis: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Coby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

episodes.title: Luffy's Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
episodes.synopsis: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

episodes.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
episodes.synopsis: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes.synopsis: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

episodes.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
episodes.synopsis: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

episodes.title: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
episodes.synopsis: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

episodes.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami arrive at an island hoping to obtain a ship and crew, but the three are quickly confronted with the blustering Captain Usopp - who has a connection to Luffy's past.

episodes.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy follows Usopp to the mansion and encounters the brutal pirate Captain Kuro. The scoundrel plans to claim Kaya's fortune and live the stolen life of luxury.

episodes.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
episodes.synopsis: Usopp spreads word of Kuro's evil plot and the impending pirate attack, but no one believes his warnings. The Straw Hat Pirates decide to help Usopp put a stop to the dastardly scheme.

episodes.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy and crew seek to best Captain Kuro, but they've prepared their defense on the wrong side of the island! All looks grim now that Usopp must face off against the Black Cat Pirates alone.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
episodes.synopsis: In an effort to save Usopp's village, the Straw Hat Pirates seek to block the marauders' path from the sea. With Luffy out of the battle, Zoro must face the fearsome Meowban Brothers!

episodes.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
episodes.synopsis: Nami manages to rescue Zoro's missing swords and attempts to revive Luffy. With one of the Meowban brothers down, the other rages on even more fiercely than before!

episodes.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
episodes.synopsis: Usopp's friends run away with the heiress Kaya. Jango races off after them, but not before sending Butchie into a berserk rage. As Zoro continues his battle, Luffy takes on Captain Kuro.

episodes.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy battles with Kuro on the beach, while the Veggies (with Kaya in tow) flee Jango the Hypnotist.

episodes.title: Angry Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
episodes.synopsis: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates' efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!

episodes.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
episodes.synopsis: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
episodes.synopsis: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world's greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.

episodes.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.

episodes.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Gin's Debt!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry's found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!

episodes.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
episodes.synopsis: The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.

episodes.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
episodes.synopsis: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!

episodes.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
episodes.synopsis: The Going Merry's been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action's not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

episodes.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
episodes.synopsis: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg's pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren't looking too good!

episodes.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
episodes.synopsis: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

episodes.title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Gin!
episodes.synopsis: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

episodes.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!
episodes.synopsis: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.

episodes.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!
episodes.synopsis: The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent's weaponry.

episodes.title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets off With Luffy!
episodes.synopsis: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

episodes.title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!
episodes.synopsis: With their culinary concerns in good hands, the Straw Hats set off in search of Nami - who's on a collision course with a deadly foe!

episodes.title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!
episodes.synopsis: Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.

episodes.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.

episodes.title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!
episodes.synopsis: A fierce argument over where Nami's loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing's for sure - no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.

episodes.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!
episodes.synopsis: Nami's adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker's younger days.

episodes.title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!
episodes.synopsis: Nojiko continues the story of Nami's younger days. Back in the present, Nami gets agonizingly close to a long time goal, but betrayal looms on the horizon.

episodes.title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!
episodes.synopsis: Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami's treasure, but who's he working for? More importantly, who's Nami working for, and what's she gonna do with her booty?

episodes.title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. the Luffy Pirates!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats' faith in Nami is restored, and now it's time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.

episodes.title: Luffy Submerged! Zoro vs. Hatchan the Octopus!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats and Arlong's fishmen are locked in a swashbuckling slugfest, but things take a bad turn when Luffy gets trapped beneath the waves.

episodes.title: Proud Warriors! Sanji and Usopp's Fierce Battles!
episodes.synopsis: While his friends work to free the captain of the Straw Hats, cowardly Usopp finds himself in a position to shed his yellow streak and make his father proud.

episodes.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!
episodes.synopsis: Nami must decide between letting Arlong maintain his hold over her, or joining the Straw Hats and leading the oppressed villagers against the tyrant fishman.

episodes.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault From the Sea!
episodes.synopsis: Arlong better watch his back-fins, because Captain Luffy knows about all the horrible things he did to Nami - and it makes his blood boil?

episodes.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
episodes.synopsis: Something about Nami's former prison gives Luffy an added burst of strength. He's so moved by her terrible past that he vows to destroy all of Arlong Park!

episodes.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
episodes.synopsis: After a grueling fight, Luffy defeats Arlong and succeeds in destroying his headquarters. The merry marauders enjoy the fruits of victory while Nami makes peace with her turbulent past.

episodes.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!
episodes.synopsis: Finally, the day has arrived where Luffy's face is on an authentic wanted poster! Now there are enemies in hot pursuit as the crew makes waves for Logue Town - final resting place of Gold Roger!

episodes.title: Chase Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure!
episodes.synopsis: Buggy gets marooned on an island inhabited by unusual creatures and tangles with the island's caretaker, Gaimon. If he is to finally destroy Luffy, Buggy must cast his lot with a mysterious woman.

episodes.title: The Wait is Over! The Return of Captain Buggy!
episodes.synopsis: The Buggy Pirates fight each other for the right to take their lost captain's place. While they're busy beating each other's brains out, a cannibalistic tribe makes plans to have something special for dinner.

episodes.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End! Landfall at Logue Town!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats arrive at Logue Town, and each crewmember embarks upon a mission of a more personal nature. While his crew shops, Luffy goes in search of sacred ground.

episodes.title: Kitetsu III and Yubashiri! Zoro’s New Swords and the Woman Sergeant Major!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy has a run-in with Captain Smoker, and his failure to keep a low profile helps Buggy draw a bead on him. Elsewhere, Zoro takes a chance that his skill can overcome a dangerous curse.

episodes.title: Usopp vs. Daddy the Parent! Showdown at High!
episodes.synopsis: Usopp finds an amazing pair of sharpshooter's goggles, but they lead to a run in with Daddy the Parent - the greatest gunslinger ever! Now, the Straw Hat marksman is headed for the deadliest of all duels.

episodes.title: Fiery Cooking Battle? Sanji vs. the Beautiful Chef!
episodes.synopsis: A cooking competition with the fiery chef Carmen rekindles Sanji's dreams of the legendary All Blue.

episodes.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man Who Smiles On the Execution Platform!
episodes.synopsis: Buggy and his mysterious female ally trap Luffy on the same platform where Gold Roger was executed. He is to be killed for his offenses against Buggy, but Zoro and Sanji attempt a daring rescue mission.

episodes.title: The Legend Has Started! Head for the Grand Line!
episodes.synopsis: As a storm batters Logue Town, Buggy, Alvida, and Captain Smoker close in on Luffy for a stirring final showdown!

episodes.title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!
episodes.synopsis: The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and his crew’s voyage to the Grand Line.

episodes.title: Miraculous Creature! Apis' Secret and the Legendary Island!
episodes.synopsis: After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament – stranded in the Calm Belt!

episodes.title: Eric Attacks! Great Escape from Warship Island!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats want to return Apis’s dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it’s time for another daring escape!

episodes.title: A Solitary Island in the Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island!
episodes.synopsis: Even for Nami, finding the dragon’s lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack – or at the bottom of the ocean.

episodes.title: Showdown in the Ruins! Tense Zoro vs. Eric!
episodes.synopsis: Nami discovers a map to the true location of the dragon’s nest, and Zorro puts his steel to the test against Eric the Whirlwind.

episodes.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Commodore Nelson's Secret Strategy!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats sail headfirst into Commodore Nelson and his Marine armada. While Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro dodge cannon balls, Eric the Whirlwind prepares a sneak attack!

episodes.title: Through the Sky They Soar! The 1000 Year Legend Lives Again!
episodes.synopsis: With their rescue mission taking on water, the Straw Hats get some surprising help from the great blue yonder.

episodes.title: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!
episodes.synopsis: Episode 61 is "half-filler" episode. The first half (00:00 - 13:00) is filler content which concludes the filler arc "Warship Island". The second half (13:00 - 24:00) is canon and the beginning of "Reverse Mountain" arc.

episodes.title: The First Line of Defense? the Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hat crew takes a wild ride up and down a mountain only to end up in the belly of a giant whale that’s on the lookout for pirates!

episodes.title: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy trades blows with Laboon the whale, and Nami is distressed to learn that navigating the Grand Line is no easy feat.

episodes.title: A Town That Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot On Whisky Peak!
episodes.synopsis: A violent snow storm batters the crew of the Going Merry, but once the Straw Hats arrive at Whisky Peak, the locals invite them to a raucous celebration.

episodes.title: Explosion! the Three Swords Style! Zoro Vs. Baroque Works!
episodes.synopsis: There are bounty hunters on the prowl, and most of the Straw Hats are dead drunk. Only Zoro is still sober enough to hoist a sword.

episodes.title: All-out Battle! Luffy Vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
episodes.synopsis: There’s a mysterious princess that needs protection from a nose-picking assassin, but Luffy and Zoro are too busy duking it out to worry about explosive boogers.

episodes.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! the Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats depart Whisky Peak on a mission to return the Princess of Alabasta to her kingdom while protecting her from an army of vicious assassins.

episodes.title: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!
episodes.synopsis: While the crew heads for Little Garden with the princess, Luffy and Zoro’s old nemesis, Axe-Hand Morgan, escapes from a Marine prison ship.

episodes.title: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
episodes.synopsis: Colby and Helmeppo train day and night to prove they’re tough enough to be Marines. A violent showdown with Vice-Admiral Garp will determine if they’re worth their salt.

episodes.title: An Ancient Island! the Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy’s gang is running low on supplies, so they stop at Little Garden to find something to eat. Unfortunately for them, it might end up the other way around.

episodes.title: Huge Duel! the Giants Dorry and Broggy!
episodes.synopsis: Not only are there dinosaurs running wild on the island of Little Garden, but the Straw Hats soon find themselves in the middle of a gargantuan grudge match.

episodes.title: Luffy Gets Angry! a Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
episodes.synopsis: Usopp and Luffy are fascinated by the endless battle waged between Dorry and Broggy; however, fascination turns to outrage when Monkey catches a whiff of treachery.

episodes.title: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy’s blood boils for revenge against the assassins who sabotaged Dorry and Broggy’s battle, but he’s currently trapped between a rock and a hard place.

episodes.title: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!
episodes.synopsis: While Luffy struggles to free himself, his friends fall into the hands of Baroque Works. Though the odds are against them, the Straw Hats will never give up!

episodes.title: A Hex On Luffy! Colors Trap!
episodes.synopsis: Nami, Zoro, and the Princess are in danger of becoming exhibits in a fiendish artist’s collection, and only Luffy can save them. But he’s busy having a cup of tea.

episodes.title: Time to Fight Back! Usopp's Quick Thinking and Fire Star!
episodes.synopsis: With his friends about to be permanently entombed in wax, Usopp is provided with the perfect opportunity to be brave and make his father proud.

episodes.title: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!
episodes.synopsis: After narrowly avoiding death, Luffy’s crew and the Princess set sail for Alabasta, but something large and dangerous looms in their path.

episodes.title: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling On the Stars!
episodes.synopsis: Nami comes down with a terrible fever and the Straw Hats don’t know what to do. Looks like the Grand Line might claim another victim.

episodes.title: A Raid! the Tin Tyrant and Tin Plate Wapol!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats continue their quest to find a doctor for Nami. Along the way, they deal with a ravenous invader and get a chilly reception from local islanders.

episodes.title: An Island Without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Sanji make a bold trek up a snow-covered mountain in search of a witch who might hold the key to curing Nami.

episodes.title: Are You Happy? the Doctor Called Witch!
episodes.synopsis: Ferocious, giant, snow rabbits slow Luffy and Sanji’s progress up the mountain. Meanwhile, the former king Wapol returns to the town he abandoned.

episodes.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Corps Land On the Island!
episodes.synopsis: Nami hovers near death while Luffy and Sanji fend off the abominable rabbits. Back at the village, Dalton leads a revolt against the dastardly Wapol.

episodes.title: The Island Where Snow Lives! Climb the Drum Rockies!
episodes.synopsis: An unlikely source acts as a roadblock to give Luffy some climbing room, and Zorro emerges from a snow bank cold, cranky, and ready to rumble

episodes.title: Blue-nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret!
episodes.synopsis: After a long journey up the mountain, Nami finally receives much-needed medical attention, but Sanji and Luffy are more interested in eating the doctor!

episodes.title: An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy recruits Tony Tony Chopper to join the Straw Hat crew as the ship’s doctor.

episodes.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will That Gets Carried On!
episodes.synopsis: Chopper’s first friend was a quack doctor who couldn’t cure a cold, but the old man still managed to teach the little reindeer how to care for people.

episodes.title: Fight Wapol's Crew! the Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy unleashes the full force of his Gum Gum fury on Wapol, and Chopper is amazed by the rubberman’s fierce devotion to the pirate flag.

episodes.title: Zoan-type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-form Transformation!
episodes.synopsis: When Wapol orders his goons to attack the Straw Hats, Chopper shows off a little something he calls the Rumble Ball!

episodes.title: When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! the Flag of Faith Flies Forever!
episodes.synopsis: Wapol attacks Nami in her weakened condition, but Monkey B. Luffy is quick to step in and even the odds.

episodes.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!
episodes.synopsis: After an explosive battle with Wapol, Luffy begins the tiring process of convincing Chopper to join his pirate gang.

episodes.title: Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
episodes.synopsis: Chopper sets sail for Alabasta with his new friends, and Dalton thinks back to his first meeting with Princess Vivi.

episodes.title: Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina On the Ship!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats rescue a man of many faces as they approach Alabasta. Sure, he’s good for a laugh, but they may regret pulling him out of the drink.

episodes.title: Off to the Desert Kingdom! the Rain-Summoning Powder and the Rebel Army!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats arrive in Alabasta with precious little time to stop the rebellion. Sanji and Chopper are sent to gather supplies for a dangerous trip across the desert.

episodes.title: The Heroes' Reunion! His Name Is Fire Fist Ace!
episodes.synopsis: Captain Smoker has Luffy in his grasp until a fiery stranger creates a diversion, giving the Straw Hats a chance to make a break for it.

episodes.title: Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!
episodes.synopsis: Ace and Luffy’s happy reunion is crudely interrupted by the Billions of Baroque Works. They may be outnumbered, but these brothers are no ordinary pirates!

episodes.title: Erumalu, the City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!
episodes.synopsis: Before they can start their trek across the desert, Luffy and the Straw Hats are stopped at the shore by the cute – but formidable – Kung Fu Dugongs.

episodes.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! the Monsters That Live in the Scorching Land!
episodes.synopsis: Luffy’s crew encounters treacherous birds and man-eating foliage on its desert odyssey, and just when they think the coast is clear, a great disturbance emerges from beneath the sand!

episodes.title: Enter the Desert Pirates! the Men Who Live Freely!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats cross paths with the Barbar Sand Pirates, and Ace runs into big trouble when he gets separated from the group.

episodes.title: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
episodes.synopsis: Princess Vivi devises a plan to test the hearts of a gang of so-called rebels. They talk a good game, but will their bite measure up to their bark?

episodes.title: Rebel Warrior Koza! the Dream Vowed to Vivi!
episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.
